changes.comment: A shared folder that appeared from another device shows what it is doing — arriving, waiting for its link, or being folded back — instead of appearing and disappearing.
Pasting the link for a shared folder that is waiting for one starts it syncing where it stands: no re-download, no file on disk changed.
The root of a shared folder can no longer be renamed, moved, deleted or shared again from the tree — each refusal says why.
Sharing a folder now records which vault it came from, so a device you link later can open that folder without you pasting its link.
A vault link and a folder link are told apart when stored, so a folder's key can never be used to reach the whole vault.
A vault that stops sharing one of its folders stays connected afterwards, instead of quietly going offline until the app was restarted.
